_doc: Module lists/titles come from material/Modulos_sec+.md and material/cissp_domain.json; this file adds
the exam domain of each module and its prerequisite module codes (same certification).
Security+ domains are the five SY0-701 domains; each module is mapped by its content to the domain
of the objectives it covers (rationale per module). Prerequisites only point to earlier modules
(acyclic): fundamentals before everything, threat actors before social engineering/malware,
malware before vulnerabilities and malicious activity, crypto + fundamentals before architecture,
architecture before infrastructure, risk management before third-party risk/governance/resilience,
governance before audits, monitoring before incident response, response before investigation
and automation, social engineering before awareness.
CISSP: modules are the 8 domains; Security and Risk Management (D1) is the foundation of all the others.

CEH: the 20 CEH v13 modules of material/ceh_modules.md; domain and prerequisites come from the CEH v13 blueprint (EC-Council CEH Exam Blueprint v5.0, module -> domain); the prerequisite order is an editorial learning order, not defined by EC-Council.

M01.rationale: SY0-701 1.1/1.2: control types, CIA, Zero Trust.

M02.rationale: 2.1/2.2: threat actors, vectors and attack surfaces.

M05.rationale: 2.4: malware and indicators of malicious activity.

M11.rationale: 4.2: asset management (change management, 1.3, is the smaller part).

M19.rationale: 4.1: secure baselines and hardening of computing resources.

M24.rationale: 4.9: data sources and digital forensics for investigations.

D1.rationale: Security and Risk Management: foundation (governance, risk, ethics).
